people.name: Elijah
people.line: A prophet during the reigns of Ahab and Ahaziah.

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

people.name: Peter
people.line: Apostle of Jesus, leader in the early church

translations.web: Peter answered Jesus, “Rabbi, it is good for us to be here. Let’s make three tents: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”
translations.bsb: Peter said to Jesus, “Rabbi, it is good for us to be here. Let us put up three shelters —one for You, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”
translations.kjv: And Peter answered and said to Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.
translations.asv: And Peter answereth and saith to Jesus, Rabbi, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elijah.
